why_single_dir: 成员用 Path(__file__).resolve().parent 定位兄弟资源（refs/、root-agent-eval/agent.py）。拆成多个顶层 skill 会让 HERE.parents[0] 变成 ~/.dsh/skills，refs 与 eval 全部失效，等于要改五个成员的代码。

verification.family_health: 含 agent.yaml 的包逐个过 doctor，全部 healthy、0 阻断
verification.discovery_rule: DSH 只扫发现根的一级子目录，认 <dir>/SKILL.md；frontmatter 必须有非空 name/description，name 须匹配 ^[\p{L}0-9]+(?:-[\p{L}0-9]+)*$，invocation 键只认 kebab-case。

commands.digest: python3 -c "import hashlib,sys;from pathlib import Path;p=Path(sys.argv[1]);h=hashlib.sha256();[h.update(str(f.relative_to(p)).encode()+b'\0'+hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest().encode()+b'\n') for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in f.parts and f.name not in ('.DS_Store','SKILL.md','install-manifest.json')];print(h.hexdigest())" /Users/lute/.dsh/skills/root-agents
commands.drift_check: [ "$(python3 -c "import hashlib,sys;from pathlib import Path;p=Path(sys.argv[1]);h=hashlib.sha256();[h.update(str(f.relative_to(p)).encode()+b'\0'+hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest().encode()+b'\n') for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in f.parts and f.name not in ('.DS_Store','SKILL.md','install-manifest.json')];print(h.hexdigest())" /Users/lute/.dsh/skills/root-agents)" = "$(python3 -c "import hashlib,sys;from pathlib import Path;p=Path(sys.argv[1]);h=hashlib.sha256();[h.update(str(f.relative_to(p)).encode()+b'\0'+hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest().encode()+b'\n') for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in f.parts and f.name not in ('.DS_Store','SKILL.md','install-manifest.json')];print(h.hexdigest())" /Users/lute/Documents/skill-test/执行skills/执行skills/skills-回归测试/root-agents)" ] && echo 一致 || echo 已漂移
commands.run_tests: cd <skill> && for s in root-agent-creater root-agent-doctor root-agent-eval root-agent-opt root-agent-check; do python3 -m unittest discover -s $s/tests -p 'test_*.py'; done
commands.family_health: for a in <skill>/*/; do [ -f "$a/agent.yaml" ] && echo "{\"agent_dir\":\"$a\"}" | python3 <skill>/root-agent-doctor/agent.py; done
